name: 21219 · Baltimore, MD
findings: ZIP 21219 (Baltimore) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (62% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21219 (Baltimore) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
